translations.web: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.
translations.bsb: So the spies went out into the hill country and stayed there three days, until their pursuers had returned without finding them, having searched all along the road.
